# brig sandbox snapshot list

List the snapshots in a VM, with the space they take

## Synopsis

```text
brig sandbox snapshot list [VM] [SANDBOX] [-w W] [-o json]
```

Also: `brig sandbox snapshot ls`.

## Description

List the snapshots of every workspace of a VM, newest first for each
sandbox, or with SANDBOX, that sandbox's snapshots in the workspace of -w or
BRIG\_WORKSPACE. -w alone lists only that workspace's.

SIZE is what a snapshot holds, EXCLUSIVE what it holds alone: the blocks it
shares with nothing else, which deleting it frees. Since a snapshot shares
its blocks with its sandbox and the other snapshots, the sizes add up to more
than the disk holds. NOTE marks snapshots whose sandbox is gone, and those an
unfinished [`brig sandbox recreate`](brig-sandbox-recreate.md) needs.

## Examples

```sh
brig sandbox snapshot list dev
brig sandbox snapshot list dev webapp -o json
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-o, --output format` | output format: table or json (default `table`) |
| `-w, --workspace string` | list only the snapshots of this workspace |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
